checks.message: Every mandatory round trip fits the schedule-specific fleet plan
Every non-hub city meets its percentile-tier hub-service minimum
Every assigned hub receives at least one round trip
Every market is at or below its applicable ceiling (3 inter-hub; 6 otherwise)
Point-to-point flying is 9.0% of planned legs
Every fleet remains within its schedule-specific aircraft-minute budget
Promoted 2 high-demand connecting round trips from CRJ200 to CRJ700
Every market uses one fleet, so pairing-spacing slots are solved without cross-fleet reservations
Every hub's planned frequency fits its gate-count, bank-count, and passenger-touch throughput

limitations: Historical point-to-point markets are retained, but historical hub/focus markets outside each city's effective tier assignments are removed before allocation.
Hub frequency is capped by the configured gates, effective bank count, bank width, and passenger-touch window; exact timing and physical gate/stand assignment remain mandatory downstream checks.
Optional point-to-point frequency is deliberately withheld; the preserved point-to-point market set must remain within the 10% schedule cap.
